agent-submission.objective: Formalize ICP-DAG v1.0 Integrity Constraint Protocol as deterministic SGMT nodes. Crystallize 10 governance invariants into Datalog/Prolog relations. Emit kernel candidates for node creation, edge validation, and constraint verification.

inputs.input: ICP-DAG.lp — Answer Set Programming constraints (39 lines)

facts.fact: EVIDENCE, CLAIM, CONSTRAINT, PROOF, DECISION, AUTHORIZATION, EXECUTION, AUDIT, POLICY
node(claim, unknown) | node(proof, proven) | node(decision, proposed) | node(execution, pending)
edge_type(supports, evidence, claim) | edge_type(proven_by, claim, proof) | edge_type(decides, proof, decision) | edge_type(executes, decision, execution)

I1: every_edge_has_existing_endpoints | I2: no_self_edges | I3: unknown_cannot_authorize | I4: contradicted_cannot_authorize | I5: execution_needs_authorized_decision | I6: proof_references_claim | I7: policy_references_constraint | I8: constraint_failure_propagates | I9: governance_failure_prevents_execution | I10: asp_unsat_halts_dag

rule.head: authorized(D)
rule.body: node(D, decision, authorized), node(C, claim, verified), edge(C, D, "decides"), proven(C)

rule.head: can_execute(E)
rule.body: node(E, execution, pending), node(D, decision, authorized), edge(D, E, "executes")

constraints.constraint: :- edge(A, B, _), not node(A, _, _). :- edge(A, B, _), not node(B, _, _).
:- node(C, claim, unknown), node(D, decision, _), edge(C, D, decides).
:- node(C, claim, contradicted), node(D, decision, _), edge(C, D, decides).
:- node(D, decision, authorized), node(C, claim, _), edge(C, D, decides), not proven(C).
:- node(E, execution, _), edge(D, E, executes), node(D, decision, S), S != authorized.
:- node(C, claim, unknown), node(C, claim, verified).

proof-obligations.obligation: For all edges (A, B), nodes A and B must exist in the DAG node set.
No node may have an edge to itself (acyclic property).
If a decision is authorized, all claims supporting it must be proven.
No claim may simultaneously hold both unknown and verified states.
The DAG must be acyclic. Reachability from any node cannot return to itself.
